fusions.name: Lazy Slap
fusions.desc: A slow, heavy slap that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 20% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Is Urgent
fusions.desc: Breathes a calm over a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 26 damage to everything in it, ignoring their resistances, and leaving each [Stalled] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Everyone Else Waits
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds, and you move 30% faster for 5 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Rested Hands
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 20% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
